what_happened: Every grounding claim in the dispatch (conclusion-stage.md Step 6 as sole emission site, postflight-tool-restrictions.md's Move 5 Bash allowlist text, runtime-file-patterns.sh resolver family, tts-notify.sh's closed-vocabulary limitation, piper invocation shape in tts-stt-integration.md, /recap name freedom in commands/ and scripts/) was confirmed live against current file state with no drift. One useful refinement found during confirmation: the recap file does not need a new RUNTIME_FILE_PATTERNS array member for gitignore purposes -- it lives under specs/.orchestration/, already covered by that directory's existing **/.orchestration/ pattern (per the 'orchestration' member's own header comment) -- it only needs a new runtime_recap_path() resolver function, mirroring runtime_conclusion_pending_marker_path(). This saved a round of re-deriving facts the dispatch already supplied.

Plan authoring surfaced two gate collisions before implementation: lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh enumerates valid commands from */commands/*.md at run time, so a /recap recommendation landing in the results template before commands/recap.md exists would be flagged (closed by making the wiring phase depend on the command phase); and suite-classification.data's header states lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh fails loudly on any discovered-but-unclassified suite, so the new suite's classification row was folded into the same phase that adds the suite.

First plan draft named per-path suite lists in three Tier Justification lines; validate-artifact.sh flagged all three as fabricated claims. Root cause measured: suite_selection_select has UNION semantics -- when any path in the phase has no mapped suite, the selector returns __FULL_SWEEP__ for the whole phase regardless of how many suites its other paths map to. Every non-final phase here creates a new file or touches an unmapped markdown file, so the honest claim is the sentinel plus a gate subset. Corrected; validator now passes with zero warnings. The real suite lists were moved into each phase's Verification block as non-covering extra checks rather than deleted.
